degree_argument: All selected generators are homogeneous of positive weighted degree <=B. Required S-polynomials and all reductions remain at weight <=B. Pair lcm weights before rejection are <=2B, and even temporary products from these pairs have exponents <=2B<=114. The 255 mask has signed power-guard capacity127. No exponent is truncated or quotiented. Reject any OVERFLOW/error; never interpret it as zero.
packing_estimate: For 458 variables on 64-bit: 16-bit default stores4 exponents/word; 8-bit mask255 stores8. Exponent-array words fall from ceil(458/4)=115 to ceil(458/8)=58, excluding fixed overhead. Total RSS reduction is not guaranteed.
